# Given data
march_2001 = 3554  # in millions
march_2006 = 34736  # in millions

n = 5

print(f"CAGR = {cagr:.6f} ({cagr*100:.2f}%)")

# Project to March 2011 (5 years from March 2006)

print(f"Projected March 2011 value: {march_2011:.2f} million")

# Verify the calculation
print(f"\nVerification:")
print(f"From 2001 to 2006: {march_2001} * (1+{cagr})^5 = {march_2001 * (1+cagr)**5:.2f}")
EOF
